title: 第一卷 人生初见 第十七章 移形换影第一卷 人生初见 第十八章 杯中月
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
南宫傲此刻的话就像是一盆水浇灭了长孙所有的希望。
长孙问天此刻也感到追悔莫及，多年的心血就要在自己眼前被他人夺走，自己唯一的亲人也将死在自己眼前。
对于长孙问天来说，死亡反而像是一种解脱。
但长孙还年轻，他还有无限的希望，长孙问天不想让他成为这场险恶争斗的陪葬者。
南宫傲此刻就像是一只捉到老鼠的猫，猎物死前的挣扎让他感到享受，长孙此刻慌张的样子就像是一只瑟瑟发抖躲在洞里的老鼠，想要挺身而出却又无计可施；长孙问天就像是猫爪下装死的老鼠，等待机会想要从猫爪下逃走，却殊不知这样才能使猫更兴奋。
“南宫傲，你能有今天的成就，不得不说真是让我刮目相看，从前那个要靠我施舍才有机会往上爬的可怜人，如今竟能走出今天这步，不错。但你终究还是那个可怜人，到了此刻，依然连站在我面前的勇气都没有，你依然是那个只敢站在远处仰望我的人。”
长孙问天颤颤巍巍的扶着墙努力的站起来，但他的语气却异常的平稳与威严。
南宫傲脸色阴晴不定，长孙问天的话让他感到恼怒，就像是最亲近的朋友戳中了心事一般，感到在对方面前无处可藏，羞愧与愤怒的情绪就要爆发。
忽然南宫傲又恢复了平静，笑着说道：“老狐狸，你这粗鄙的激将法在我面前不管用，我已经胜券在握，我只需在这等着你毒发，然后再上去给你一刀，一切就结束了。你想骗我到你身前，你以为我不懂狗急跳墙的道理么。”
长孙问天此刻已站立起来，但全身无力使他只能后背抵到墙上，才能不让自己摔倒。
南宫傲脸色越来越难看，此刻眼前颤颤巍巍的长孙问天却仿佛化作了一道天堑，在南宫傲心里越来越高大，越来越难以逾越。
南宫傲从跟随长孙问天的那天起便将长孙问天作为目标来崇拜、来追赶，但无论南宫傲如何努力的追赶都只能望其项背，甚至长孙问天从未回头看过自己一眼，因为他从未将自己视为过对手。
南宫傲生活在长孙问天的身影里，直到今天自己终于能够站在他面前，向他发起挑战，才发现他的目光依然不在自己身上，自己从未得到过重视。
羞辱从心底生出，愤怒在羞辱中爆发。
愤怒将南宫傲的自信与理智燃成灰烬。
南宫傲难以抑制的颤抖，然而即使如此长孙问天似乎依然没有在意自己。
终于南宫傲再也控制不住自己，体内的真气如同朝阳照亮大陆一般，瞬间充斥身体的每一个角落。
只见南宫傲右脚猛然发力，还未来得及眨眼便冲到长孙问天的身前，右手如同雄鹰扑兔一般一把牢牢的掐住长孙问天的脖子，凶猛的势头硬是将长孙问天撞入石墙内。
“长孙问天，从我追随你那刻开始，我就无时无刻的不想超过你，为此我付出常人数倍的努力，但你却连作为对手的尊严都不给我。现在你后悔了吧，此刻你就像是一条死狗一般在我的股掌之中，只要我稍稍用力就能要了你的命。哈哈哈，是你的自负，目中无人害了你自己。你现在求我啊，求我饶你一命啊，哈哈哈哈…”
南宫傲此刻状若疯颠，长孙问天像是断了气一般没了动静，血顺着南宫傲的手臂滴到地上，那是长孙问天的血。

“咳…不是我的自负，是你的自卑摧毁了你。”石墙里传出长孙问天吃力的声音。
“我从未把你当成对手，因为你曾是我培养出来的孩子，是你的自卑把你变成了我的敌人。”长孙问天接着说道。
“你…你曾把我当成是你的孩子…”南宫傲心中忽然出现了一丝颤抖。
就在南宫傲心烦意乱的一刻，长孙问天忽然抬起原本无力的右手，瞬间抓住南宫傲扼住自己脖子的手臂。
“既然已经是我的敌人我就不会再有任何的留情。”长孙问天体内原本死寂的真气忽然运转起来。
“这…这是，移形换影？！”
长孙问天死寂的真气忽然快速的运转起来让南宫傲慌了神，而此刻长孙问天使出的“移形换影”更是让南宫傲惊疑不定。
“移形换影”南宫傲十分熟悉，这是长孙问天成名的身法，长孙问天征战之初便是靠着这套神出鬼没的身法取敌人将帅首级于千军万马之中。
南宫傲还因此而求着长孙问天教学，但学习数日而不得其法，最终还是放弃了。
此刻让南宫傲感到害怕的是长孙问天使出这招却并非是身法，而是将他的肝脏与自己调换，此等变招是南宫傲想所未想。
南宫傲竭尽全力想要挣脱，却发现自己怎么也逃不出长孙问天手掌的控制。
“你眼力倒是不差，还能认出来，虽是你年轻于我，但在这里你落后于我。”长孙问天右手抓着南宫傲，从石墙中走出，左手指指自己的大脑，示意南宫傲的想法迂腐，无法超前于自己。
“你…你将你的肝脏跟我的交换，你这是自杀…你，你的肝脏有毒…”南宫傲惊恐于长孙问天的话，更是惊恐于长孙问天的能力。
从开始长孙问天就在将他的毒逼于肝脏之内，之后用尽言语之利，逼自己出手，寻找机会控制自己，给施展法术制造条件。
“哇…”长孙问天一口血吐出，长孙问天此刻搏命的方式虽然控制住了南宫傲，但自己受的伤却更重。
体内大部分毒虽然都被逼到了肝脏，再用移形换影转移到了南宫傲体内，但长孙问天也因此而伤到了根本。
长孙问天咳出一口黑血后，气息忽然飙升，仿佛一头打盹的狮子忽然清醒，南宫傲越来越惊恐，此刻的长孙问天就像是没有中毒受伤一般，磅礴的气势击溃其心中所有的自信。
长孙问天一把将已经吓傻的南宫傲甩到一边，然后调动起体内活络的真气，对着众人长啸一声。
“吼…”众人面前仿佛出现一头张口择人欲噬的狮子，恐怖的气势顿时压倒众人，即使是训练有素的天行者亲卫也乱了阵脚，实力弱者甚至跌坐在地。
长孙问天一声长啸之后，环视众人，然后径直向长孙走去，稳健的步伐没有一丝刚才羸弱的影子。

长孙也被突然转变的局势搞得措手不及。
看着向自己走来的爷爷，长孙也怔住了，直到长孙问天抓住自己，然后突然运气冲出大厅。
大厅内的众人被长孙问天的气势所震慑，看着长孙问天带着长孙夺门而出，竟无一人制止。
直到南宫傲怪叫一声才将众人惊醒。
“给我抓住他们！！”南宫傲此刻虽然稳定了气息，吃了解药，但已全无刚才的气势。
content_en:
Nangong Ao's words at this moment were like a basin of water extinguishing all the hopes of the eldest grandson.
Changsun Wentian also felt extremely regretful at this moment. His years of hard work were about to be taken away by others in front of his eyes, and his only relative was about to die in front of his eyes.
For Changsun Wentian, death seemed like a relief.
But the eldest grandson is still young, and he still has unlimited hope. The eldest grandson Wentian does not want him to be a casualty of this dangerous battle.
Nangong Ao was like a cat that caught a mouse. He enjoyed the struggle of the prey before it died. Changsun's panic at this moment was like a trembling mouse hiding in a hole, trying to get out but was unable to do anything. Changsun Wentian was like a mouse pretending to be dead under the cat's claws, waiting for an opportunity to escape from the cat's claws, but little did he know that doing so would make the cat more excited.
"Nangong Ao, I have to say that you are able to achieve what you have achieved today. I have to say that I am impressed. The poor man who had to rely on my charity to have a chance to climb up has now come this far. It is good. But after all, you are still the poor man. At this moment, you still don't even have the courage to stand in front of me. You are still the one who only dares to stand in the distance and look up at me."
Changsun Wentian tremblingly stood up while holding on to the wall, but his tone was unusually calm and dignified.
Nangong Ao's face was gloomy and uncertain. Changsun Wentian's words made him feel angry, as if his closest friend had stabbed something in his heart. He felt that he had nowhere to hide in front of the other person, and his emotions of shame and anger were about to explode.
Suddenly, Nangong Ao regained his composure and said with a smile: "Old fox, your crude provoking method won't work in front of me. I already have a chance to win. I just need to wait here for you to get poisoned, and then go up and give you a knife, and it will be over. You want to trick me into getting in front of you, do you think I don't understand the principle of a dog jumping over a wall in a hurry?"
Changsun Wentian had stood up at this moment, but his whole body was so weak that he could only press his back against the wall to prevent himself from falling.
Nangong Ao's face became more and more ugly. At this moment, the trembling Changsun Wentian in front of him seemed to have turned into a chasm. In Nangong Ao's heart, he became taller and taller, becoming more and more difficult to overcome.
Nangong Ao has worshiped and chased Changsun Wentian as his goal since the day he followed Changsun Wentian, but no matter how hard Nangong Ao tried to catch up, he could only fall behind. Changsun Wentian never even looked back at him because he had never regarded himself as an opponent.
Nangong Ao lived in the shadow of Changsun Wentian. It was not until today that he was finally able to stand in front of him and challenge him that he realized that his eyes were still not on him and that he had never been taken seriously.
Humiliation arises from the bottom of the heart, and anger breaks out in humiliation.
Anger burned Nangong Ao's confidence and reason to ashes.
Nangong Ao could not suppress his trembling, but even so, Changsun Wentian still didn't seem to care about him.
Finally, Nangong Ao couldn't control himself anymore. The true energy in his body filled every corner of his body like the rising sun illuminating the continent.
I saw Nangong Ao's right foot suddenly exerting force. Before he could blink, he rushed in front of Changsun Wentian. His right hand grabbed Changsun Wentian's neck tightly like an eagle attacking a rabbit. The fierce momentum forced Changsun Wentian into the stone wall.
"Changsun Wentian, from the moment I followed you, I never wanted to surpass you. I worked twice as hard as an ordinary person, but you didn't even give me the dignity of an opponent. Now you regret it, you are like a dead dog in my palm, and I can kill you as long as I exert a little force. Hahaha, it is your pride and arrogance that has harmed yourself. Please beg me now, beg me to spare your life, hahahaha..."
Nangong Ao was in a state of madness at this moment. Changsun Wentian seemed to have died, and there was no movement. Blood dripped down Nangong Ao's arm to the ground. That was Changsun Wentian's blood.
"Ahem...it's not my pride, it's yoursHumiliation destroys you. " Changsun Wentian's labored voice came from the stone wall.
"I have never regarded you as an opponent, because you were once a child I trained, and it was your inferiority complex that turned you into my enemy. " Changsun Wentian continued.
"You...you once regarded me as your child..." Nangong Ao suddenly felt a tremor in his heart.
At the moment when Nangong Ao was upset, Changsun Wentian suddenly raised his weak right hand and instantly grabbed Nangong Ao's arm that was strangling his neck.
“Since you are already my enemy, I will not show any mercy. "The originally dead energy in Changsun Wentian's body suddenly began to circulate.
"This...this is, Apparition? ! "
Changsun Wentian's dead energy suddenly started to circulate rapidly, which made Nangong Ao panic. At this moment, Changsun Wentian's "disappearance" made Nangong Ao even more frightened and confused.
"Transformation" is very familiar to Nangong Ao. This is the movement technique that Changsun Wentian became famous for. At the beginning of the campaign, Changsun Wentian relied on this elusive movement technique to kill the enemy general's head in the midst of thousands of troops.
Nangong Ao also asked Changsun Wentian for teaching because of this, but after studying for several days and failing to find the method, he finally gave up.
What frightened Nangong Ao at this moment was that Changsun Wentang's move was not a physical move, but a way to swap his liver with his own. This change of move was something Nangong Ao had never imagined.
Nangong Ao tried his best to break free, but found that he could not escape from the control of Changsun Wentian.
"Your eyesight is not bad, and you can still recognize it. Although you are younger than me, you are lagging behind me here. Changsun Wentian grabbed Nangong Ao with his right hand and walked out of the stone wall. He pointed at his brain with his left hand, indicating that Nangong Ao's ideas were pedantic and could not get ahead of him.
"You...you exchanged your liver with mine. You are committing suicide...you, your liver is poisonous..." Nangong Ao was frightened by Changsun Wentian's words, and even more frightened by Changsun Wentian's ability.
From the beginning, Changsun Wentian had been forcing his poison into his liver, and then used all his words to force himself to take action, looking for opportunities to control himself and create conditions for casting spells.
"Wow..." Changsun Wentian spat out a mouthful of blood. Although Changsun Wentian was fighting for his life to control Nangong Ao, he was even more seriously injured.
Although most of the poison in the body was forced to the liver and then transferred into Nangong Ao's body through apparation, Changsun Wentian was also seriously injured due to this.
After Changsun Wentian coughed up a mouthful of black blood, his breath suddenly soared, like a dozing lion suddenly waking up. Nangong Ao became more and more frightened. At this moment, Changsun Wentian seemed as if he was not poisoned and injured. The majestic momentum destroyed all the self-confidence in his heart.
Changsun Wentian threw the frightened Nangong Ao aside, then mobilized the active energy in his body and roared at the crowd.
"Roar..." A lion seemed to appear in front of everyone, opening its mouth to devour others. The terrifying momentum immediately overwhelmed everyone. Even the well-trained Skywalker guards were confused, and the weak ones even fell to the ground.
After Changsun Wentian let out a long roar, he looked around at everyone, and then walked straight towards Changsun, with a steady pace that showed no trace of the frailty he had just shown.
Changsun was also caught off guard by the sudden change of situation.
Looking at his grandfather walking towards him, the eldest grandson was also stunned until eldest grandson Wentian caught him and suddenly rushed out of the hall.
Everyone in the hall was shocked by Changsun Wentian's momentum. They watched Changsun Wentian lead his eldest grandson out of the door, but no one stopped him.
It wasn't until Nangong Ao screamed that everyone woke up.
"Catch them! ! "Although Nangong Ao has stabilized his breath at this moment and took the antidote, he no longer has the same momentum as before.
